description: 해양경찰청_관제구역 내 교통량 및 교신량 [roads, bridges and tunnels and fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 해양경찰청. 최근 기록된 2019년에서 부터 2024년까지의 전국 모든 선박교통 관제구역 내에서 발생한 선박들의 교통량과 교신량에 관한 데이터를 제공합니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 해양경찰청. Its tags are 교통량, 교신량, 관제구역, 단위, 연도별. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-25 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
